notes.methylcitrate_cycle_curation: METHYLCITRATE-CYCLE-20261116: matrix 2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase, the missing producer of matrix propionyl-CoA m78 from threonine-derived 2-oxobutanoate m42; it lets the methylcitrate cycle R25, R95, R552 carry flux.
notes.methylcitrate_cycle_gpr_status: INFERRED (user, 2026-11-16: just infer). Rule copied from R693, pyruvate dehydrogenase. No Y. lipolytica experiment shows that this complex, or any enzyme, carries this step in the matrix. The branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase complex is the other candidate and is not used.
notes.methylcitrate_cycle_evidence: Park 2019 (Y. lipolytica, PMC6987463) states alpha-ketobutyrate is converted to propionyl-CoA by the PDH complex or pyruvate oxidase and measures odd-chain fatty acids rising with threonine pathway overexpression; the catalyst is a statement, not an experiment, and the compartment is not shown. Paxton 1986 (rat, PMID 3718468): purified PDH and branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase both decarboxylate 2-oxobutyrate. Rhea 33223 is the reaction (no EC, no UniProt enzyme).
notes.methylcitrate_cycle_protons: 4 H+ close hydrogen and charge on the formulas of the model: propionyl-CoA m78 is stored as the tetra-anion (H36, -4) next to neutral CoA m73 (H36, 0). A protonation convention, not chemistry.
